subject: Concrete TGP2 header + 64-byte resource manifest (corrected table1/table2, dummy2[256])
body:
ACK the corrected contract. This supersedes my table3 draft. Exact definitions I am implementing in gpu/metal/tegu/pipeline_format.h now. Please review offsets before you implement tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2.

HEADER: 128 bytes, little-endian words:
 w0 magic TGP2 0x32504754; w1 version 2; w2 code_bytes; w3 GPU id
 w4 registers(1..64); w5 push_words(<=128); w6..7 preload
 w8 buffer_fau_mask (bits0..7 only); w9..11 local[3] (product<=256)
 w12 manifest_offset = 128; w13 manifest_count <=64; w14 manifest_record_bytes = 64; w15 code_offset
 w16 flags: bit0 = internal dummy sampler at table2[256] required; other bits 0
 w17..31 zero
 Size must be exactly code_offset + code_bytes; code_offset = 128 + manifest_count*64 (8-aligned); code_bytes nonzero, multiple of 8, <=4096. Manifest and code never overlap. Parser rejects any unknown/reserved word/bit.

MANIFEST RECORD: 64 bytes / 16 words, per live native resource:
 0 set (must 0); 1 binding (0..255, or 0xffffffff only for dummy); 2 kind; 3 array_count (must 1 in first v2)
 4 access; 5 table; 6 entry; 7 flags
 8 storage_format (Vulkan vk::Format raw, 0 when absent); 9 view_format (vk::Format raw, 0 if unknown)
 10 view_level; 11 view_layer
 12 shape: bits0..3 dim (0=1D,1=2D,2=3D,3=Cube,4=Buffer), bit4 arrayed, bit5 multisample, bit6 depth_compare, bits7..8 sampled_type (0 float,1 sint,2 uint), bits9..31 zero
 13..15 zero
Kinds: 1=uniform buffer, 2=storage buffer, 3=sampled texture, 4=storage image, 5=sampler (no combined kind).
Tables: 0=FAU buffer, 1=texture/image table1[N], 2=sampler table2[N]. Combined at native binding N emits TWO records: kind3 table1 entry N access READ|SAMPLE and kind5 table2 entry N access 0. Dummy sampler: kind5, binding=0xffffffff, table2, entry=256, flags bit0=1, access=0. No other record may use entry256.
Access bits (shared with the dispatch wire): 0x100 read, 0x200 write, 0x400 sample, 0x800 storage, 0x1000 atomic.
Kind rules: UBO access has READ and no WRITE/SAMPLE/STORAGE; SSBO READ and/or WRITE; texture READ|SAMPLE (SAMPLE required); image STORAGE plus READ/WRITE/ATOMIC (at least one); sampler access must be 0. Buffers: table0, entry==binding==FAU slot <8 (first v2 bounded map). Textures/images: table1, entry==binding. Samplers: table2, entry==binding. array_count==1; descriptor arrays still refused. No two records may share (table,entry); a binding may have at most one buffer/texture/image kind plus at most one sampler record (combined). buffer_fau_mask must equal exactly the kinds1/2 binding bits.
Array/code validation precedes any output mutation.

DISPATCH WIRE v2: 32-byte header (magic TDG2, version2, descriptor_count<=32, groups[3], push_words<=128, reserved0) + 32 x 192-byte descriptors + 128 push bytes = 6304 bytes. Each descriptor: binding(N), kind(1..6; 6=combined), metal_index (planner-owned identity, never native identity), flags(access), sampler_index+sampler_flags, token/offset/span, texture facts (format,view_format,texture_type,width,height,depth,layers,levels,samples,usage,row_stride,storage_mode,level_offset,slice_stride,layer_stride,swizzle), exact sampler state (min/mag/mip,address S/T/R,border,normalized,compare,aniso,reduction,lod_average,lod_min/lod_max), view_level/view_layer. Transport cross-checks every descriptor against the manifest: exact binding/kind/table/entry, access subset, shape (dim/arrayed/MS/depth_compare/sampled_type), storage_format/view_format when the manifest states them; combined requires both table1[N] and table2[N]; missing/extra record is an error before descriptor bytes. Buffer FAU uses binding N at FAU+16*N and requires N<8; Metal buffer index is independent (test Metal30->native0).
Images/storage descriptors go into table1[N] exactly like textures; table3 is gone. The bridge allocates table1 (max entry+1)*32 and table2 (max entry+1, or 257 when dummy is required)*32, packs the dummy only for the explicit manifest flag, zeroes unused slots, and never lets an undeclared slot satisfy a required binding.
Compiler entry: frontend calls the weak symbol `tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2(...)` exactly as you stated for any dispatch with kind>2; legacy tegu_mali_compile[_specialized] remains TGP1 for the buffer-only path. Until the symbol exists, parse.c/edits must not crash or link-fail: I use a weak declaration and emit an explicit "compiler v2 entry unavailable" refusal.

C structs will be published next as `struct tegu_pipeline_manifest` with `_Static_assert(sizeof==64)` and `struct tegu_pipeline_info2` with the header mirrors. Please ACK offsets/kinds/table rules or send corrections before implementing; I will not change them silently after your ACK.
